title: Two US senators demand answers from TikTok about a "depraved" test that withheld a safety feature from 10% of US users, including a teenager who died by suicide (Olivia Carville/Bloomberg)
summary: Olivia Carville / Bloomberg: Two US senators demand answers from TikTok about a “depraved” test that withheld a safety feature from 10% of US users, including a teenager who died by suicide — Two US senators have sent a letter to TikTok executives demanding answers about an experiment the company ran …
